# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 OmniNode.ai Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Overlay of the two reads the factory floor makes inside the runtime host's containers (OMN-22549).

The fleet observation and the build provenance live in different service containers of the runtime host. Which
container holds which file is a deployment fact, so it is an overlay value and not code: the overlay
``runtime_host_reads`` names the ssh target variable, the compose project, the service holding each file, the
provenance file's path and, per repository, where in that file its deployed ref is and where its clone is.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field


class ModelRuntimeRepoRef(BaseModel):
    """Where one repository's deployed ref sits in the provenance file, and where its clone is under the registry home."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    repo: str = Field(pattern=r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$")
    clone_relpath: str = Field(pattern=r"^[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$")
    ref_path: tuple[str, ...] = Field(min_length=1)


class ModelRuntimeHostReadOverlay(BaseModel):
    """The container identities and the provenance layout the floor reads over ssh."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    ssh_host_env: str = Field(pattern=r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$")
    compose_project: str = Field(pattern=r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$")
    fleet_service: str = Field(pattern=r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$")
    provenance_service: str = Field(pattern=r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$")
    provenance_path: str = Field(pattern=r"^/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$")
    # The registry home on the runtime host. A build can run a commit the reader's own clone never fetched (a branch
    # install, a declared rollback); the history of that commit is then read from the clone the runtime host has, at
    # this home plus the repository's ``clone_relpath``. Unset: only the reader's own clone answers.
    runtime_clone_home: str | None = Field(default=None, pattern=r"^/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$")
    repo_refs: tuple[ModelRuntimeRepoRef, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
    timeout_seconds: int = Field(default=30, gt=0)

class PublishRefusedError(RuntimeError):

def run_process(
    argv: Sequence[str], stdin: bytes | None, timeout: int
) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:
    """The one subprocess boundary of this node; tests replace it."""
    try:
        return subprocess.run(
            list(argv), input=stdin, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout, check=False
        )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        raise PublishRefusedError(
            f"{argv[0]} did not finish within {timeout} s"

def _time(value: str) -> datetime:
    stamp = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    if stamp.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError("projection timestamp has no UTC offset")
    return stamp.astimezone(UTC)


def _rung(
    backend: str, tier: str, model: str, policy: ModelDelegationReportPolicy
) -> str:
    for group in policy.groups:
        if (
            tier in group.tiers
            or backend.startswith(group.backend_prefixes)
            or any(part in backend for part in group.backend_contains)
            or model.casefold().startswith(group.model_prefixes)
        ):
            return group.name
    return policy.fallback_group


def _outcome(attempt: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    decision = attempt.get("acceptance_decision")
    if decision == "accept" or (
        decision is None
        and attempt.get("tier") == "harness"
        and attempt.get("quality_gate_passed") is True
    ):
        return "accepted"
    if decision in {"reject", "refuse", "refused"}:
        return "refused"
    if attempt.get("failure_class"):
        return "failed"
    return "unknown"


def _terminal_outcome(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    if row.get("quality_gate_passed") is True and row.get("terminal_ok") is not False:
        return "accepted"
    if row.get("operational_outcome") in {
        "quality_rejected",
        "refused_before_dispatch",
    }:
        return "refused"
    if row.get("terminal_ok") is False:
        return "failed"
    return "unknown"

    }
    for values in outcomes.values():
        verdict = next(
            name
            for name in ("accepted", "refused", "failed", "unknown")
            if name in values

        cause += " No real projection run tried a local rung in 24h."
    return {
        "schema": "delegation-floor/1",
        "status": "read",
        "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
        "positive_control_rows": snapshot["total_rows"],
        "latest_local": snapshot.get("latest_local"),
        "windows": windows,
        "endpoints": endpoints,
        "cause": cause,
        "outcomes": [],
        "why": cause,
    }


def tick_line(report: dict[str, Any], *, lanes_running: int) -> str:
    if report.get("status") != "read":
        return f"UNREAD delegation-local 2h reason={report.get('reason', 'projection unread')} FIX: read the lab delegation projection and its positive control"
    window = report["windows"]["2h"]
    local, total = window["local_runs"], window["total_runs"]
    status = "MISSING" if (lanes_running > 0 or total > 0) and local == 0 else "OK"
    line = f"{status} delegation-local 2h local={local}/{total} delegated lanes={lanes_running} newest_local={report.get('latest_local') or 'never recorded'}"
    return f"{line} FIX: {FIX}" if status == "MISSING" else line


class HandlerDelegationReport:
    """The existing publisher's read seam, also callable by the session tick."""

    def __init__(self, runner: Runner | None = None) -> None:
        self._run = run_process if runner is None else runner

    def handle(
        self,
        request: ModelDelegationReportRequest,
        *,
        environ: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
    ) -> ModelDelegationReportResult:
        env = os.environ if environ is None else environ
        try:
            overlay = request.overlay or load_structured_overlay(
                "delegation_health",
                ModelDelegationReadOverlay,
                env,
                file_env="DELEGATION_HEALTH_OVERLAY_PATH",
            )
            host = env.get(overlay.ssh_host_env, "").strip()
            if not host:
                raise ValueError(f"{overlay.ssh_host_env} is unset")
            unit = 'unit() { docker ps --filter "label=com.docker.compose.project=$1" --filter "label=com.docker.compose.service=$2" --filter status=running --format \'{{.Names}}\' | head -1; }'
            script = "\n".join(
                [
                    "set -eu",
                    unit,
                    f"DB=$(unit {overlay.compose_project} {overlay.postgres_service})",
                    f"RT=$(unit {overlay.compose_project} {overlay.runtime_service})",
                    '[ -n "$DB" ] && [ -n "$RT" ]',
                    f"docker exec -i \"$DB\" psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U {overlay.db_user} -d {overlay.database} -tA <<'SQL'",
                    READ_SQL,
                    "SQL",
                    "echo @@CONFIG",
                    f'docker exec -i "$RT" python3 - {"probe" if request.probe else "read"} '
                    + shlex.quote(
                        json.dumps([e.model_dump() for e in overlay.probe_endpoints])
                    )
                    + " <<'PY'",
                    CONFIG_PY,
                    "PY",
                ]
            )
            result = self._run(
                [
                    "ssh",
                    "-o",
                    "BatchMode=yes",
                    "-o",
                    "ConnectTimeout=10",
                    "--",
                    host,
                    "bash -s",
                ],
                script.encode(),
                request.timeout_seconds,
            )
            if result.returncode:
                raise ValueError(f"lab projection read exited {result.returncode}")
            data, config = result.stdout.decode().split("@@CONFIG", 1)
            inventory = json.loads(config)
            report = delegation_report(json.loads(data), inventory["endpoints"])
            report["chains"] = inventory["chains"]
        except (
            OSError,
            PublishRefusedError,
            ValueError,
            KeyError,
            TypeError,
            NodeOverlayError,
            subprocess.TimeoutExpired,
        ) as exc:
            report = {
                "status": "unread",
                "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
                "reason": str(exc),
                "outcomes": [],
            }
        return ModelDelegationReportResult(
            report=report, tick=tick_line(report, lanes_running=request.lanes_running)
        )

"""Read the canonical fleet producer's file, without adding another observer.

The producer and publisher run on different hosts. Read the file in the runtime
container that consumes fleet observations, using its installed contract and
state directory. A failed read replaces old local counts with an unread result.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from collections.abc import Mapping
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from omnimarket.handlers.node_overlay_reader import (
    NodeOverlayError,
    load_structured_overlay,
)
from omnimarket.models.model_factory_floor_input import (
    ModelFloorRunner,

)
from omnimarket.models.model_runtime_host_reads import ModelRuntimeHostReadOverlay
from omnimarket.nodes.node_factory_floor_publish_effect.handlers.handler_delegation_report import (
    PublishRefusedError,
    Runner,
    run_process,
)
from omnimarket.nodes.node_factory_floor_publish_effect.models.model_fleet_observation_source import (
    ModelFleetObservationSourceRequest,
    ModelFleetObservationSourceResult,
)

READ_FLEET_PY = """
# @@FLEET: read the file owned by the existing bus projection.
import json, os, sys
from importlib.resources import files
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
try:
 contract = yaml.safe_load(files('omnimarket.nodes.node_projection_runner_fleet').joinpath('contract.yaml').read_text())
 declared = contract['state_file']
 directory = os.environ.get(declared['dir_env'], '').strip()
 if not directory:
  raise ValueError(declared['dir_env'] + ' is unset in the fleet consumer')
 sys.stdout.write((Path(directory) / declared['relpath']).read_text())
except (OSError, KeyError, ValueError) as exc:
 print(json.dumps({'status': 'unread', 'reason': 'fleet producer: ' + str(exc)}))
"""


class HandlerFleetObservationSource:
    """The publisher's read seam for the bus producer's saved observation."""

    def __init__(self, runner: Runner | None = None) -> None:
        self._run = run_process if runner is None else runner

    def handle(
        self,
        request: ModelFleetObservationSourceRequest,
        *,
        environ: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
    ) -> ModelFleetObservationSourceResult:
        env = os.environ if environ is None else environ
        document: dict[str, Any]
        try:
            overlay = request.overlay or load_structured_overlay(
                "runtime_host_reads",
                ModelRuntimeHostReadOverlay,
                env,
                file_env="RUNTIME_HOST_READS_OVERLAY_PATH",
            )
            host = env.get(overlay.ssh_host_env, "").strip()
            if not host:
                raise ValueError(f"{overlay.ssh_host_env} is unset")
            script = "\n".join(
                [
                    "set -eu",
                    "RT=$(docker ps --filter "
                    f"label=com.docker.compose.project={overlay.compose_project} --filter "
                    f"label=com.docker.compose.service={overlay.fleet_service} "
                    "--filter status=running --format '{{.Names}}' | head -1)",
                    '[ -n "$RT" ]',
                    "docker exec -i \"$RT\" python3 - <<'PY'",
                    READ_FLEET_PY,
                    "PY",
                ]
            )
            result = self._run(
                [
                    "ssh",
                    "-o",
                    "BatchMode=yes",
                    "-o",
                    "ConnectTimeout=10",
                    "--",
                    host,
                    "bash -s",
                ],
                script.encode(),
                request.timeout_seconds,
            )
            if result.returncode:
                raise ValueError(f"fleet producer read exited {result.returncode}")
            data = json.loads(result.stdout)
            if not isinstance(data, dict):
                raise ValueError("fleet producer output is not an object")
            if data.get("status") == "unread":
                raise ValueError(str(data.get("reason") or "fleet producer unread"))
            fleet = ModelFloorRunnerFleet(
                observed_at=data["observed_at"],
                runners=tuple(
                    ModelFloorRunner(
                        host_label=row["host"],
                        status=row["status"],
                        runner_name=row.get("runner_name"),
                        label_class=row.get("label_class"),
                        labels=tuple(row.get("labels") or ()),
                    )
                    for row in data["runners"]
                ),
            )
            document = {
                "status": "read",
                "observed_at": fleet.observed_at.isoformat(),
                "runners": [
                    {
                        "host": row.host_label,
                        "status": row.status,
                        "runner_name": row.runner_name,
                        "label_class": row.label_class,
                        "labels": list(row.labels),
                    }
                    for row in fleet.runners
                ],
            }
        except (
            OSError,
            ValueError,
            KeyError,
            TypeError,
            NodeOverlayError,
            PublishRefusedError,
        ) as exc:
            document = {
                "status": "unread",
                "reason": str(exc),
                "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
            }
        return ModelFleetObservationSourceResult(document=document)
